question.text: How frequently must comprehensive cyber audits be conducted at a QRTA?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates comprehensive cyber audits at least twice in a financial year for Qualified RTAs (QRTAs). This frequency ensures any emerging vulnerabilities are identified and addressed promptly. The Trap: This is separate from the annual systems audit and the quarterly DR drills required of QRTAs. Comprehensive cyber audits specifically must happen at least twice per financial year. Note: The hierarchy applicable to QRTAs is: quarterly DR drills, semi-annual comprehensive cyber audits, and an annual systems audit, each with a different scope and frequency.
